FM: FCC FM Query (fmq, licensed + CP), pulled 2026-10-23. Airband/airports/runways: FAA NASR 28-day subscription, cycle 2026-10-01 (next 2026-10-29). ZIP positions: US Census 2024 ZCTA gazetteer.
